specs.Metrics Measured: Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Breath Rate, Heart Rate, Sleep Duration
specs.Target Audience: Men, Unisex Adults, Unisex Youth, Women

features: Comprehensive Health Monitoring: With Aabo Ring get Sleep Score with in-depth analysis of your sleep patterns & overnight metrics like SpO2, respiratory rate & resting heart rate. The daily monitoring of your heart rate and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) provides timely detection of any changes in your cardiac health. The ring also measures finger temperature variations to detect shifts in temperature & offers early insight into your overall health dynamics.

Personalized Stress Management: A standout feature is its capability to detect and track moments of stress triggers, providing valuable data for implementing effective recovery tactics and helping you bounce back faster. Readiness Score is derived from key metrics - Heart rate, HRV, Finger Temperature & total sleep This comprehensive approach ensures that Aabo Ring is not just a sleep tracker but a holistic tool for your overall well-being.

Durable and Lightweight Design: Crafted from premium Titanium Metal, our health ring offers both durability and lightness, ensuring comfort throughout the day. Wear it without compromise as it seamlessly integrates into your daily routine.

Waterproof and Swim-Friendly: With an impressive IP68 water resistance rating, this smart ring can accompany you in daily activities, including bathing and swimming up to 50 meters deep. Unlike wrist-based trackers, finger signals remain strong even in water.

Wireless Charging and Extended Battery Life: Enjoy the convenience of wireless charging and a remarkable battery life of 4 to 7 days. With a quick charging time of 60 to 80 minutes, aabo fitness ring ensures that you stay connected to your health insights without disruptions.
